Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
BANDAGE, SUSPENSORY 



CO 
to 

0» 



1. Scope — Constructional and other requirements for suspensory bandage. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1, 2 and 3. 

3. Materials 

3.1 The body of the bandage shall be made from good quality white cotton drill conforming to 
variety No. 1 of IS : 177-1977 ' Specification for cotton drills (third revision ) \ 

3.2 Pouch shall be made from fabric knitted from soft spun 29'5 tex (20's) hosiery yarn with min 
average lea strength of 270 N and weight Min 153 g/rtr and having following structure: 

Wales per 5 cm — 50 
Courses per 5 cm — 60 
Holes per cm- — 12 

3.3 Sewing Thread— Cotton sewing thread of 9'8 tex 6 ( or 60's x 6 ) conforming to Variety No. 31 
of IS : 1720-1978 ' Specification for cotton sewing threads ( second revision ) \ 

3.4 Buckle — 22 mm with two teeth conforming to Table 8 of IS : 4274-1957 'Specification for 
buckles '. 

3.5 Tape Newar ~~ 25 mm undyed (bleached) Variety No. 7 of IS : 1895-1970 'Specification for 
cotton tape NEWAR, grey or dyed ( first revision ) '. 

3.6 Tape elastic 22 ^ 2 mm and 5 ± 1 mm conforming to IS : 9686-1980 ' Tape, elastic '. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 All sewing shall be done with lock stitches by turning in the free ends to depth as shown 
in Fig. 2. 

4.2 The bandage shall be tailored neatly out of the cotton drill, knitted cloth and tape. The vales 
shall run along the length of the pouch. 

4.3 The bandage shall fit with the anatomy and give proper support to scrotum. 

4.4 ThepH value of aqueous extract of textile material used shall be between 6*5 and 8'5. 

5. Marking 

5.1 A cloth label of suitable size shall be securely stitched to each bandage indicating the 
following: 

a) Manufacturer's name, initials or registered trade-mark, if any; and 

b) Any other information. 

5.2 ISI Certification Marking - Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

6. Packing — The bandage shall be packed according to the best trade practice or as desired 
by the purchaser. 



Adopted 2 March 1961 



May 1981, ISI 



INDIAN STANDARDS INSTITUTION 
MANAK BHAVAN, 9 BAHADUR SHAH ZAFAR MARG 
NEW DELHI 110002

TO 
IS : 9751-1981 SPECIFICATION FOR 
BANDAGE, SUSPENSORY 

Alterations 

( Page 1, clause 5.1 ) — Substitute the following for the existing 
clause: 

'5.1 A cloth label of suitable size shall be securely stitched to each 
bandage indicating the following: 

a) Manufacturer's name, initials or registered trade-mark, if any; 

b) Size of the bandage indicated as: 

1 ) infants and children, 

2) adults — small, and 

3) adults — large. 

according to the dimensions A and B in Fig. 3; and 

c) Any other information. ' 

( Page I, clause 6 ) — Substitute the following for the existing clause: 

'6. Packing — The bandage shall br so packed that dust and other part- 
iculate contamination docs not reach the bandage inside the packing.' 

( Page 3, Fig. 3 ) — Substitute the following figure given on pag^ 2 
for the existing figure. 

Addendum 

( Page 1, clause 4.4 ) — Add the following new clause after 4.4: 

f 4.5 The suspensory bandage shall be surgically clean, namely, resemble 
a freshly laundered unused cloth.'
